title: Junior Backend Engineer
text:
Junior Backend Engineer
TechMahindra Digital | Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)

About the role
We build the APIs and services that power millions of daily transactions for our fintech platform. We are hiring a junior backend engineer with 0-2 years of experience.

What you'll do
- Design and build REST APIs and background services in Python and Django
- Model data in PostgreSQL and optimise slow queries with proper indexing
- Cache hot paths with Redis and keep p95 latency under 200 ms
- Write unit and integration tests and review pull requests in Git

What we're looking for
- 0-2 years of relevant experience
- Hands-on experience with:
- Python
- Django
- PostgreSQL
- Git
- SQL
- Strong problem-solving skills and clear communication
- Nice to have: Kafka, Terraform, GraphQL

We offer a competitive salary, health insurance, learning budget and flexible hours.
